name: Louisiana: Louisiana State Uniform Construction Code (IRC 2021 with Louisiana amendments)

review.note: Adopts IRC 2021 (Louisiana Uniform Construction Code Commission; LAC 17:I.107). Amendments were researched for stairs, ceiling height, light and ventilation only; every other rule (room size, egress, escape openings, electrical, alarms) is the base code's.
